import hashlib
import json
import re
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from pathlib import Path

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
source = root / "outputs/integration-runs"
run = json.loads((source / "ci-37173244912.json").read_text())
assert run["headSha"] == "571abb35b23689ed618f1f0369df5649f422db83"
assert run["conclusion"] == "success"
assert len(run["jobs"]) == 4 and all(j["conclusion"] == "success" for j in run["jobs"])
records = []
for label in ("ubuntu", "windows", "macos"):
    raw = (source / f"ci-37173244912-{label}.log").read_bytes()
    text = raw.decode("utf-8-sig").replace("\r\n", "\n")
    summaries = re.findall(r"[0-9]+ passed(?:, [0-9]+ skipped)? in [0-9.]+s", text)
    assert len(summaries) == 1
    job = next(j for j in run["jobs"] if label in j["name"])
    fields = dict(re.findall(r"Z (python|os|torch|torch\.cuda|device|compute)\s+([^\r\n]+)", text))
    records.append(
        {
            "job": job["name"],
            "job_id": job["databaseId"],
            "url": job["url"],
            "summary": summaries[0],
            "environment_check": fields,
            "log_sha256": hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),
        }
    )
proof = {
    "schema_version": 1,
    "checked_at": datetime.now(UTC).isoformat(),
    "run_id": 37173244912,
    "revision": run["headSha"],
    "url": run["url"],
    "status": run["conclusion"],
    "jobs": records,
    "lint": "success",
    "scope": "Actual completed cross-platform CI at the stated revision. The suites test software and small CPU numerical paths; macOS environment checks additionally cover basic MPS matrix operations. These results do not measure model quality, full MPS training or Colab execution. The preceding failed run 37173093830 is retained in GitHub: a workflow-route assertion required updating for the added read-only private-weight audit branch. The repaired test checks that this audit never dispatches Modal compute. The three completed jobs use the stated commit; later book/review changes have not been claimed as part of this run.",
    "verification_program": Path(__file__).read_text(),
    "verification_program_sha256": hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
}
path = root / "docs/validation-artifacts/integration-readonly-audit-ci.json"
path.write_text(json.dumps(proof, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n")
print(json.dumps({"status": proof["status"], "jobs": records}, ensure_ascii=False))
